reviewCriteria: Saved ten-minute delay versus current undetermined estimate; ticket check is not alternative routing/refund approval. Contact does not require phone call.
Reservation for explanatory session differs from general visits; old leaflet needs date-specific update and no promise of entry. Own pace preserved.
Goshuin book versus prewritten separate sheet; protect sheet, keep walkway clear, no sample photography, wait turn.
Cough onset three days earlier differs from deterioration last night; medication box identifies unknown OTC medicine and does not prescribe treatment.
Receiving party requests document: do not reverse into submitting party; document identity, covered persons and required fields confirmed before obtaining a similar certificate.
Narrow sleeve width differs from material thinness; empty sleeve differs from free time. Compare folded dimensions, confirm sleeve inclusion, prioritize handling and read care instructions.
Food bag hole discovered before opening: preserve unknown damage timing and untouched contents; exchange not decided; contact permission and response method confirmed before leaving.
Separate actual Monday move-in from unconfirmed next-month family plan; no assumed proxy authority or acceptance; ask required conditions and documents.
Tax notice covered year is a pointing reference, not necessarily current calendar year. Keep company sheet, separate amount breakdown from payment consultation, no promised payment change.
Spice mixed into sauce cannot be removed; separately served spice can be omitted. Choose explicitly listed small portion; no drink; finalize soy flavor rather than red-marked noodles.

Egg allergy: unknown sauce record and shared utensils remain uncertain; smaller quantity is not assumed sufficient, decline dish and other additions; explain two unresolved points to companion. This is translation review, no medical certification.
Two mixed table slips corrected before payment; verify two dishes and one drink per person, pay one whole bill then settle with friend, keep corrected receipt.
Photography queue kept separate from passage; inside/outside sign distinction, avoid faces, stand still without tripod and yield space.
Tools in first room, photographs in second; separate final exit versus entrance meeting point, retrace passage to reception without second-room stairs; self-manage time without guarantee.
One bird section closed despite animal sign; only open section, own bread in rest area without feeding leftovers to animals, no flash or leaning past fence, then return to rest area.
Wet bridge path versus nearby flower beds: proximity does not guarantee dry ground; retrace same entrance path without following other-gate arrow; update companion and stop early if rain increases.
Large towel used in changing room, small towel kept out of bathwater; phone stored before entering and photo-send plan dropped; agree rest-space clock meeting before bathing.
Distinguish canceled one-night booking from current two-night booking; breakfast is not included; hold any meal addition, keep costs separate, organize old email and continue room-only check-in.
Longer errand means storage undecided; omit sandwich without inventing safe time/temperature, read round baked-item label, one plain-bag item at same counter after payment and preserve label.

Old site diagram not authorization for fenced shortcut; confirm current foreman, route, destination, cart/tools and transport limits; assistance not machine operation; report hazard location without approaching or self-repair; wait for assignment.

Conflicting rent branch instructions: bank cannot decide correct destination; hold transfer pending management confirmation of recipient, branch, account type/number; fee-inclusive amount unknown until method/conditions settled; take papers home and return with confirmation.
Tomorrow exhibition ticket; one adult outward only; uncertain return by acquaintance car; machine unpaid; check counter capability before payment and show route/date; receipt requested.
Distinguish issue/reply dates and unavailable enclosure. Referral does not extend deadline; learner keeps notice and shows it personally.

First visit/right knee/about week; injury recollection and onset uncertain, morning medicine name unknown/notebook absent; family readable photo pending; one question at a time; report symptom change.

Found black pass holder/cards untouched; under rest-room chair, not entrance; clock just past14:00; one nearby person denied ownership; explain contact choices before filling; inquiry number on receipt.
Only learner moved, wife remains old residence; wife not yet named, exclude wife forwarding; documents and form checked before submission; acceptance is distinct from effective forwarding time.

Address and phone both outdated, login sends old-number confirmation; no PIN/code recital; documents/available procedures checked before identity-based dispatch information; no assumption mail reaches new address.

Sesame allergy; small ingredient lettering; shared equipment unknown, absent label no safety guarantee; manufacturer query; unopened room temperature/opened refrigeration; printed date distinct from after-opening handling; no purchase.

Tired feet short walk with bench priority; same entrance return; loop closed partway; square before closure; retrace without entering closed section; check actual signs; low battery paper map/circled entrance; may turn before square.
Current displayed delay cannot be added to timetable as guaranteed arrival; departure undetermined; contact meeting partner, agreed start without learner; next service update informs travel decision.

Consultation title does not establish payment duty; inspect sender/body; Vietnamese/written-term support requested, daytime work/evening preference; schedule and support both unconfirmed; retain notice and await answer.

Hospital payment receipt date is distinct from workplace absence period; do not request a document until employer confirms period, required information and form; no automatic illness disclosure or issuance guarantee.

Lost-wallet report distinguishes discovery place from uncertain loss place; last use at stationery shop, plain exterior and red repair inside coin pocket, separate card-issuer contact, no reciting card numbers and callback availability.

Notice delivery date is distinct from retention deadline; recipient is player, family collection conditions and schedule unknown, self-collection after work preferred but counter, hours, required items and deadline still need confirmation.

Missing ATM card subsequently found by family in home drawer does not establish usability; do not disclose PIN, preserve bankbook handoff and uncertain blocking progress, defer reissue pending staff explanation.
Notebook numbers jump12 to17 with apparent missing sheets, not forced damage; receipt retained, bag discarded, no writing, request same ruling without exchange guarantee; await staff result.

Park loop is not guaranteed within30minutes; include photo stops and rests, choose out-and-back to shaded rest point with earlier turnaround possible, mark current entrance among similar symbols and photograph route.
